decisions.title: Remove salvage
decisions.summary: Salvage path was removed after confirming it was effectively unreachable.
decisions.rationale: Keeping unreachable recovery logic increases complexity without improving coverage.
decisions.impact: Pipeline logic is simpler and Phase 1 coverage remains unchanged.

decisions.title: No Phase1B rule
decisions.summary: Do not introduce a Phase1B rule without a safe precision-preserving pattern.
decisions.rationale: Unsafe heuristics would produce noisy mappings and reduce trust.
decisions.impact: Scope stays on Phase 1A and D until a safe rule exists.

decisions.title: AI alias outputs require review before approval
decisions.summary: Candidate generation is AI-assisted, but approved mappings remain deterministic and reviewed.
decisions.rationale: This keeps recall gains without surrendering precision control.
decisions.impact: Alias builder is designed as generate-review-approve, not autonomous mutation.

risks.title: Phase 1 rule expansion may reduce precision
risks.description: Join coverage gains can backfire if they are not anchored in safe patterns.
risks.mitigation: Record the exact reason for each rule and reject anything that cannot preserve precision.
risks.trigger: A shortcut heuristic is proposed without a defensible error bound.

risks.title: Alias review queue may grow faster than approvals
risks.description: Candidate generation can outpace human review if the review unit is too coarse.
risks.mitigation: Keep review batches small and store only approved mappings in the deterministic layer.
risks.trigger: More than one review batch remains pending across two sessions.

risks.title: Core pipeline may receive too many incidental touches
risks.description: Frequent cross-track edits in production code raise regression risk.
risks.mitigation: Limit active tracks to three and route most new work into backlog until current focus clears.
risks.trigger: An unrelated feature requests production edits during active Phase 1 work.
